WITH candidates AS (SELECT workspace_id,journey_id,customer_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS b(workspace_id uuid,journey_id uuid,version_id uuid,cohort_at timestamptz,customer_id text,deltas jsonb,created_at timestamptz) WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT workspace_id,$2::uuid,customer_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS b(workspace_id uuid,journey_id uuid,version_id uuid,cohort_at timestamptz,customer_id text,deltas jsonb,created_at timestamptz) WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL), added AS (INSERT INTO metric_customers SELECT * FROM candidates ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING workspace_id,journey_id) INSERT INTO metric_totals(workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric,value) SELECT workspace_id,journey_id,$3,$4,$5,$6,count(*) FROM added GROUP BY workspace_id,journey_id ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric) DO UPDATE SET value=metric_totals.value+excluded.value

WITH claimed AS (SELECT id FROM metric_queue ORDER BY id LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED),removed AS (DELETE FROM metric_queue q USING claimed c WHERE q.id=c.id RETURNING q.*) SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)),$2::jsonb) FROM removed r

WITH expanded AS (SELECT b.workspace_id,b.journey_id,b.version_id,date_trunc($2,b.cohort_at AT TIME ZONE $3) AT TIME ZONE $4 AS bucket,d->>$5 AS dimension,d->>$6 AS dimension_key,d->>$7 AS metric,(d->>$8)::double precision AS value FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS b(workspace_id uuid,journey_id uuid,version_id uuid,cohort_at timestamptz,customer_id text,deltas jsonb,created_at timestamptz) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(b.deltas) d), totals AS (INSERT INTO metric_totals SELECT workspace_id,COALESCE(journey_id,$9),COALESCE(version_id,$10),dimension,dimension_key,metric,sum(value) FROM expanded WHERE dimension<>$11 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS((workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric),(workspace_id,journey_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric),(workspace_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric)) HAVING sum(value)<>$12 AND (dimension<>$13 OR grouping(version_id)=$14) ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric) DO UPDATE SET value=metric_totals.value+excluded.value RETURNING $15), journeys AS (INSERT INTO metric_totals SELECT workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric,sum(value) FROM expanded WHERE dimension=$16 GROUP BY workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric HAVING sum(value)<>$17 ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric) DO UPDATE SET value=metric_totals.value+excluded.value RETURNING $18) INSERT INTO metric_hourly SELECT workspace_id,COALESCE(journey_id,$19),COALESCE(version_id,$20),bucket,dimension,dimension_key,metric,sum(value) FROM expanded WHERE dimension IN ($21,$22) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS((workspace_id,journey_id,version_id,bucket,dimension,dimension_key,metric),(workspace_id,journey_id,bucket,dimension,dimension_key,metric),(workspace_id,bucket,dimension,dimension_key,metric)) HAVING sum(value)<>$23 ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,journey_id,bucket,version_id,dimension,dimension_key,metric) DO UPDATE SET value=metric_hour

 SELECT j.id FROM scheduled_jobs j
 WHERE j.state=$3 AND j.due_at<=$1
 AND (SELECT e.state IN ($4,$5) AND f.status IN ($6,$7)
      FROM journey_executions e JOIN journeys f ON f.id=e.journey_id WHERE e.id=j.execution_id)
 ORDER BY j.due_at,j.id LIMIT $2 FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED

SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC,r.id DESC),$5::jsonb) FROM (SELECT j.*,v.version,jsonb_build_object($6,COALESCE(m.entries,$7),$8,COALESCE(m.active,$9),$10,COALESCE(m.completed,$11),$12,COALESCE(m.converted,$13)) AS stats FROM (SELECT id,name,description,tags,status,revision,current_version_id,updated_at FROM journeys WHERE workspace_id=$1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) j LEFT JOIN journey_versions v ON v.id=j.current_version_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (sum(value) FILTER(WHERE metric=$14))::bigint AS entries,(sum(value) FILTER(WHERE metric IN ($15,$16)))::bigint AS active,(sum(value) FILTER(WHERE metric=$17))::bigint AS completed,(sum(value) FILTER(WHERE metric=$18))::bigint AS converted FROM metric_totals WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND journey_id=j.id AND version_id=$4::uuid AND dimension=$19)m ON $20) r

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

method: Real loopback HTTP ingestion and actual PostgreSQL runtime/delivery/projector, warm local Docker database. Fixture creates 1,000 inactive draft journeys and synthetic customers. Stage A reaches the requested number of simultaneously WAITING durable executions (MVP threshold: 10,000). Stage B moves only isolated fixture timer deadlines to a common wall-clock time five seconds ahead, then lets real workers process. No frozen clock, SMTP or LLM requests. Completion polling interval is 1s; Go memory includes benchmark client+API+worker in one process. Two transient mock provider outcomes (429/500) are injected. Five authenticated UI reads/sec run throughout the loaded phases. pg_stat_statements records top-level statement execution (including trigger cost); client network/round-trip time is not included. Timer lateness measures step completion after due_at, not claim time. EXPLAIN probes do not modify job state. Metrics/SQL timing and bounded queue sampling are enabled; no trace exporter is started. Optional pacing and provider delay are declared in the report. Successful-attempt latency excludes earlier 429 waits; logical latency includes them.
